plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Modern Languages — French Option (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] At least three hours must be in MATH. Three hours may be PHIL 240 .
[grid1 fn2] FREN 101 and FREN 102 are prerequisites for intermediate FREN courses and will count as general electives in the degree plan. If you choose to enroll in a language you have studied previously without receiving college credit, you must first take a placement test. See the Foreign Language paragraph.
[grid1 fn3] See the Minor Field of Study paragraph.
[grid1 fn4] Minimum of 6 hours at the 400-level.
